observation.visible_scene: A single lit tealight candle in a low round metal cup sits on the left side of the frame on a gray, softly blurred wooden surface. The cup holds orange-tinted wax with a shallow melted pool around a short dark curved wick; a small bright reflection of the flame sits on the wax surface. The right two-thirds of the frame are empty out-of-focus background. The candle, cup, wick, and background stay in fixed positions throughout the excerpt.
visible_changes: The flame burns continuously and flickers: its height, width, and lean oscillate from frame to frame, with the tip curving left and right and the body stretching and contracting slightly.
The bright reflection on the melted wax pool shifts and changes size in step with the flame's flicker.
No other object moves; the candle body, wax level, wick, and background remain static, indicating a fixed camera rather than object or camera translation.
outside_clip_unknowns: What causes the flame's lean and flicker (air draft, ventilation, or natural instability) is not shown.
The state of the candle before this excerpt and whether it will burn down or go out afterward are not visible.
uncertain_details: Any very slight camera drift cannot be confirmed because background and candle positions relative to the frame edges stay essentially constant.
The exact wax composition and cup material are not identifiable from the images alone.
